purpose: Teach: そぐわない/優劣/ケープ/コロニー/歌人/死人/ビジネスチャンス/スンニ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、企業文化にそぐわない人材は採用するな
lines.en: Don't hire people who don't fit our company culture.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Declarative on each phrase. No warmth — this is principle, delivered as settled fact. Slight forward lean in the posture of command.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の優劣を競争で煽る人事は避けます
lines.en: Understood. We'll avoid hiring practices that pit staff against each other through competition.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Steady cadence. Lean slightly forward — showing he's absorbed the instruction and is already translating it into action. Professional, not obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、南アフリカのケープタウンに支社を開設しろ
lines.en: Establish a branch office in Cape Town for our company.
lines.style: Assured, measured tempo. Each phrase lands with clarity. This is a directive, not a suggestion — delivered with the composure of someone used to being obeyed. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新興市場をコロニーとせず、対等取引します
lines.en: Understood. We'll treat emerging markets as partners, not territories — conducting business on equal terms.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful. Slight pause before the second clause — showing he's not just repeating orders but thinking through the ethical weight. Calm, mature register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内報の歌人コーナーを作れ
lines.en: Create a poetry corner in the company newsletter.
lines.style: Direct, almost casual compared to the previous commands. Brief rhythm. The ease of someone who has learned this particular executive likes small, human touches in his company culture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。死人、つまりお亡くなりになった社員のご遺族への配慮を徹底します
lines.en: Understood. We'll make sure to handle the families of deceased employees with the utmost respect and care.
lines.style: Quieter register here — the tone drops in deference to the gravity of the request. Slower pace. Gentle but firm conviction that this matters. No performance, just weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界のビジネスチャンスを逃すな
lines.en: Make sure our company doesn't miss business opportunities in the industry.
lines.style: Sharp, urgent undertone without raising volume. Forward momentum — this is about action and vigilance. The kind of instruction that expects immediate strategic thinking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中東のスンニ派、つまりスンニ圏との取引も検討します
lines.en: Understood. We're also exploring business relationships with Sunni-majority markets in the Middle East.
lines.style: Confident, specific. Ends with quiet finality — a closing statement that shows adaptation and readiness. Grounded, professional. No hesitation.
